# Documentation templates

- [Intake review](intake.md)
- [Architecture decision](adr.md)
- [Engineering specification](specification.md)
- [Implementation plan](implementation-plan.md)
- [Verification evidence](evidence.md)

Templates are drafting aids, not accepted records. Replace placeholders, retain
source provenance and record real review decisions. The machine-readable
[intake contract](../intake/README.md) is authoritative for manifests.
